# PBS Projects

A full-stack commercial website for PBS Projects, a Zimbabwean construction and project management company.

## What it does

Showcases the company's services, portfolio, and team. Allows prospective clients to request quotes directly through the site. Features a curated gallery, client testimonials, and a contact form.

## Pages

- / — Home and hero section
- /products — Services and offerings
- /gallery — Project photo gallery
- /about — Company background and team
- /quote — Quote request form
- /testimonial — Client testimonials
- /contact — Contact information and form

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- Backend: FastAPI, Python
- Media: Cloudinary
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render (API)

## Live

https://pbs-projects.vercel.app
